verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation of participant notification systems, in-meeting disclosure banners, or admin-enforced consent controls — only general enterprise security features (SSO, audit logs) unrelated to meeting-participant consent. Community evidence actively shows the opposite: Otter's bot joined meetings and shared transcripts with all participants by default without their prior knowledge (otter-comm-2, otter-comm-3, otter-comm-7, otter-comm-8), indicating no real consent/disclosure mechanism exists.
